stepTitle: Is there a unique solution to the optimal parameters $$\theta$$ that minimizes MSE for the model $$\hat{y}=\operatorname{f_{\theta}}\left(x\right)=\theta_0+\theta_1 x_1+\operatorname{\theta_2}\left(8x_1-1\right)+\operatorname{\theta_3}\left(3x_2+5\right)$$?
stepBody: We have a dataset $$\{(x_{i1},x_{i2},y_i)\}_{i=1}**n$$, $$where$$ $$features$$ $$1$$ $$and$$ $$2$$ $$are$$ $$x_{i1}$$, $$x_{i2}$$ and the target is $$y_i$$.
